articles.title: Live: French PM meets with student groups; may replace Parcoursup admissions platform within 2 years
articles.description: Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu will meet with high school groups this evening about a proposal to replace higher education admissions platform Parcoursup within two years. President Emmanuel Macron earlier said public order would be maintained without the need for a state of emergency, while noting it was not “off-limits" if “things were to deteriorate". Follow our live blog for all the latest updates.

related.title: French PM meets student representatives after weeks of protests

articles.title: Lula wins fourth term: What are the reactions in Brazil?
articles.description: Brazil's leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva was re-elected against all expectations on Sunday (October 25), but his conservative rival Flavio Bolsonaro refused to accept the loss and said he would seek to have the vote annulled. FRANCE 24's Jan Onoszko tells us more.

related.title: Lula wins Brazil election but faces uphill battle to govern

articles.title: US midterms: Obama blasts Trump's 'chaos and cruelty' while campaigning for Democrats

articles.title: Will Netanyahu's security promise win him this election?
articles.description: Since the beginning of his political career, Benjamin Netanyahu, Israel's longest-serving prime minister, has campaigned on a promise that he is the only one who will keep the Jewish state safe. articles.title: Lula beats Bolsonaro in Brazil runoff: What does it mean for Donald Trump?

articles.title: Algeria to send troops to Niger in first foreign deployment in over 50 years
